<a id="schema-policyvalues"></a>

### PolicyValues

The owner's live settings (``meshforge-agent policy`` keys). In a PUT,
absent keys stay as they are; ``null`` on a limit removes the limit.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accept_gpu_sessions` | boolean (nullable) | no | - |
| `accept_jobs` | boolean (nullable) | no | - |
| `allow_network` | boolean (nullable) | no | - |
| `allow_unsandboxed` | boolean (nullable) | no | - |
| `allowed_users` | array of string (nullable) | no | - |
| `max_cpu_jobs` | integer (nullable) | no | - |
| `max_cpu_percent` | integer (nullable) | no | - |
| `max_gpu_jobs` | integer (nullable) | no | - |
| `max_ram_bytes` | integer (nullable) | no | - |
| `max_vram_bytes` | integer (nullable) | no | - |
| `pause_benchmarks` | boolean (nullable) | no | - |
